name: Bubbles pets salon
address: Muwaileh commercial - Alkhaf 7 building - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates
owner_description:
Get your four legged friends pampered and spoiled with us!
We got everything your pet needs from grooming to pet food, accessories etc
Every service or purchase done in our store, 50% of it goes towards helping homeless animals of the UAE.

reviews.author: Ansherina Sauri
reviews.text:
It was our first visit to Bubbles Pet Salon, and we had a great experience! The grooming was clean and gentle, and my dog looked so comfortable throughout the visit. The staff were all friendly, patient, and you could really tell they genuinely love and care for dogs.

I also got to spend some time playing with their lovely rescue dogs, which made my visit even more special. It made me so happy to see how well they’re cared for. We’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️🐾
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you so much for your lovely feedback🫶🏽
